description: GenClass is an open-source (Apache-2.0) browser library, @genclass/runtime, that reports race conditions in web apps while they happen: stale responses that land over newer data, duplicate requests such as double submits, inconsistent state and failure storms. A small model runs on the user's device in a Web Worker. The repository also holds @genclass/mcp, an MCP server that lets coding agents re-run a page with its network responses in different orders and replay one order.
rules: Observe, the default mode, only reports: it never holds, delays or changes a request, a response or a state write. The exception is the agent link (connectAgent) in a development build, which can hold response deliveries but never changes them.
Describe a model detection as possible, not as a confirmed bug; each report lists the evidence to check.
Visual checks are deterministic measurements with documented thresholds, reported as kind "check"; they are not model findings.
Call connectAgent from @genclass/runtime/agent only inside a development-build check; by default it returns an inert connection on a page not served from the developer's machine.
While the newest runtime line is a prerelease, it installs as @genclass/runtime@beta; npm's latest is then an older line that lacks some APIs documented on main.
